description: This file defines the 'Voucher' controller class within the OpenCart admin system, handling functionalities related to sale vouchers, such as listing, creating, editing, and deleting vouchers. It includes methods for rendering forms, listing vouchers with sorting, filtering, and pagination, and managing voucher details.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale vouchers in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that loads the voucher list page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of vouchers by calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves, sorts, filters, and paginates the list of vouchers for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles the display and processing of the voucher creation/edit form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving (adding or editing) a voucher based on POST data.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays voucher history details for a specific voucher.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves formatted history entries for a voucher, including pagination.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending voucher notifications via email.
